title: VUA inspection evidence document v0.1 (BG-4 DRAFT — contract prep, NOT frozen)
description: One inspection run's evidence bundle for one avatar across the five M7 dimensions (functional, performance, dependencies, lighting, upload readiness). DRAFT (proposal 016, BOARD ticket BG-4): this schema text is a draft for cross-role arbitration — core (persistence/routing) and environment (fact-source review) stances land in the proposal thread; the freeze hard-preconditions (a producing Bridge operation, a consuming route, positive/negative vectors plus consumer tests, bilingual protocol document) must all be met and accepted before any freeze is declared. Never registered in docs/REGISTRY.md while in draft. Honest-gap anchors: the only producing operations today are the v1 validate_avatar typed checks (functional) and the v1 analyze_performance local structural estimate (performance, basis=bridge_local_estimate, explicitly NOT an official VRChat performance rating); dependencies/lighting/upload-readiness have no producing operation yet and surface as status=unavailable with basis=none — an absent dimension is stated, never guessed.

inspectionId.description: VUA-generated inspection identity (uuid v7), same identity convention as the production-evidence entry (W23): generated by the AMF side when the inspection run is recorded; consumers reference it, never re-derive it.

avatarRef.description: Which avatar was inspected. ref is a namespaced identity when one exists (warehouse:<itemId> entry, project-scoped avatar id) or an explicit scene path when no identity exists yet; label is the observed display name, never invented.

performedAt.description: When the inspection run was executed (RFC 3339). A statement about when the checks ran, never about when facts became true.

bridge.description: The Bridge run context this evidence was transcribed from (transcription, not interpretation — Build Record discipline). One inspection evidence document maps to one Bridge inspection session: the ordered v1/v2 operations whose replies feed the dimensions below.

editorVersion.description: The Unity editor the checks ran in. The global production editor is 2022.3.22f1 exactly (workspace discipline); other values are a migration-input statement, not a supported target.

bridgeSchemaVersion.description: Wire schema major the producing operations spoke (unity-bridge v1 checks / v2 production jobs).

operations.description: Ordered transcription of the Bridge operations consumed by this inspection run. commandId is the receipt identity / comparison key (Build Record jobs[] discipline); status is the Bridge receipt status vocabulary subset relevant to checks (succeeded | failed | rejected).

dimensions.description: The five M7 inspection dimensions. Each dimension appears at most once (enforced by consumer convention and the vector tests; JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness by key directly). A dimension the producing operations cannot observe yet MUST appear as status=unavailable with basis=none and an empty checks array — the absence is part of the evidence.

kind.description: Closed vocabulary. functional = avatar structure/attachment/type-check results (today: v1 validate_avatar); performance = structural performance facts (today: v1 analyze_performance local estimate — never an official VRChat rank unless basis=official_sdk_rating exists); dependencies = package/asset dependency facts; lighting = light/probe/lighting-related facts; upload_readiness = SDK-upload preparation facts (naming, platform target, thumbnail pipeline).

status.description: pass = checks ran and all non-info findings are clean; warn = checks ran, warnings present; fail = checks ran and at least one error finding present; unavailable = no producing operation exists yet (honest gap, basis=none).

basis.description: Where the facts came from. bridge_typed_checks = typed Bridge check replies; bridge_local_estimate = Bridge-local structural estimation (analyze_performance discipline: explicitly not an official rating); official_sdk_rating = an actual VRChat SDK rating read (no producing operation exists yet — reserved, do not use until the SDK handoff slice lands); static_analysis = static file/package analysis without a Bridge run; none = the dimension was not observable in this run.

checks.description: Individual findings for this dimension. Empty only for status=unavailable. severity uses the Bridge diagnostics vocabulary (error|warning|info); code is the typed finding code, dot-namespaced like Bridge diagnostic codes.

metrics.description: Optional observed numeric/string facts backing the finding (e.g. analyze_performance's skinnedMeshRenderers/materialSlots/bones/triangles). Transcribed values only — never derived guesses.

overallStatus.description: Aggregation over dimensions (rule declared in proposal 016): fail if any dimension is fail; else warn if any dimension is warn or unavailable; else pass. Unavailable degrades to warn overall — an incomplete inspection must not read as a clean pass.

notes.description: Optional honest annotation (e.g. that the performance basis is a local estimate, or that a dimension is pending the SDK-handoff slice). Never a claim about facts the run did not observe.
